chapter: Les Hite, Sebastian's and Duke Ellington
title: Personnel of McKinney's Cotton Pickers
summary: Royal names the members of the McKinney's Cotton Pickers band that played Sebastian's.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who was in McKinney's Cotton Pickers (inaudible)? when they were here?
Well, had a first trumpet player by the

name of Langston Curl, Joe Smith was playing a second trumpet, playing all the ballads. Another guy by the name of Buddy Lee (PHONETIC) was playing the high notes. Quentin Jackson (PHONETIC) was the vocalist in the band. Another boy by the name of Coffee (PHONETIC) was playing lead trombone in the band and Cuba Austin Cue Boston (PHONETIC) was the drummer. They had a (inaudible) saxophone player. It was a guy by the name of Prince (PHONETIC), that worked for -- he was a tenor saxophone player. He played for years with the old Fats Waller group.
Oh, Dave Wilburn (PHONETIC) was the banjo player. (Todd-ed.) Rhodes Another fellow by the name of Rolls (PHONETIC) was playing piano and they were all good musicians out of the Detroit area.
